title: Persona, archetype and Journey or Circle topics never reach Google Analytics or Vercel Analytics

source.ref: Frequency Launch Build Brief, owner, 2026-10-06; gap report /mnt/project-files/launch/2026-10-06-launch-sweep.md

detail: WORKSTREAM 10 and a rule of the road in the launch brief (ADR-1720): "Wellness data never reaches ad or analytics pixels. That includes persona, archetype, Journey topics and Circle topics." LIVE TODAY: app/join/(induction)/persona-log.ts:42-50 sends feature.used {persona, personas} through track(), and lib/analytics/track.ts mirrors every event to GA4 Measurement Protocol, skipping the consent check whenever the visitor is anonymous (track.ts:97), which they always are at that step. trackClient mirrors raw props to gtag (components/analytics/track-provider.tsx:22). lib/analytics/sanitize.ts checks key shape only, with no denylist. Page views carry /journeys/<slug> and Circle paths. THE FIX: a sensitive-key denylist (persona, personas, archetype, arrival answer, mood, topic, journey, circle) stripped in the shared sanitizer before any GA mirror, persona-log stops sending persona, and page_view paths for Journeys, Circles and topics collapse to their route pattern. The demographic rollout (LIVE-790 series) adds archetype on top of this guard.

verify.cmd: node -e 'const fs=require("fs"),p=require("path");const r=f=>fs.existsSync(f)?fs.readFileSync(f,"utf8"):"";const walk=(d,o=[])=>{if(!fs.existsSync(d))return o;for(const e of fs.readdirSync(d,{withFileTypes:true})){const q=p.join(d,e.name);if(e.isDirectory()){if(e.name!=="node_modules")walk(q,o)}else if(/\.(tsx?|mjs|md)$/.test(e.name))o.push(q)}return o};const fail=m=>{console.error(m);process.exit(1)};const ID="LIVE-810";const s=r("lib/analytics/sanitize.ts")+r("lib/analytics/ga-server.ts")+r("lib/analytics/track.ts");if(!/persona/.test(s)||!/archetype/.test(s))fail(ID+": the analytics sanitizer has no persona and archetype denylist");const pl=r("app/join/(induction)/persona-log.ts");const call=pl.slice(pl.indexOf("track("),pl.indexOf("track(")+400);if(/^\s*persona,|\bpersonas:/m.test(call))fail(ID+": persona-log still sends persona to track()")'
verify.note: Fails while the sanitizer has no persona/archetype denylist or persona-log still passes persona to track().
